Calibrate a model with DDS

Source: R/calibrate.R
calibrate_model.Rd

Calibrate a model with DDS

Usage

calibrate_model(
  model_fn,
  bounds,
  obs,
  score_idx,
  objective = kge,
  maximize = TRUE,
  n_evals = 1000,
  r = 0.2,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

model_fn

function(par) -> numeric vector aligned with obs.

bounds

Output of param_bounds().

obs

Observed series.

score_idx

Integer or logical index of days used in the objective.

objective

function(obs, sim) -> numeric. Default kge.

maximize

TRUE for efficiencies (NSE/KGE), FALSE for errors.

n_evals

Total model runs. ~1000 is enough for ~8 parameters; scale up with the number of free parameters.

r

DDS perturbation size as a fraction of each parameter range.

seed

RNG seed for reproducibility.

Value

list(best = named list of all parameters, value = objective, trace = best-so-far objective per evaluation)
